service.description: Reads a data-defined endpoint into one extract file ({records, metadata}), by the run's window or by lookup keys, with the run's exclusion rules applied and the excluded records written beside it. Same output contract as every coded extract.

parameter.name: systemEnumId
parameter.description: The endpoint read: its connector row names the definition.

parameter.name: sourceConfigId
parameter.description: The config id, when the caller does not send it under the connector's configParameterName.

parameter.name: windowStart
parameter.description: Window start, under the connector's dateFromParameterName (windowStart when blank).

parameter.name: lookupKeys
parameter.description: Read only these records by key, instead of the window.

parameter.name: lookupKeyField
parameter.description: The field lookupKeys are values of; the definition says which it accepts and its default.

parameter.name: sourceFilters
parameter.description: Exclusion rules, under the connector's filterParameterName.

parameter.name: companyUserGroupId
parameter.description: The run's tenant; the config must be its own or shared with it.
